name: Seafile
summary: Private file sync, sharing, and browser-based file access.

catalog.description: Seafile is a self-hosted file sync and sharing server for private libraries, browser access, desktop sync clients, mobile clients, and share links.

features.title: Sync files across devices
features.body: Use Seafile desktop and mobile clients with a MOS-hosted server.

features.title: Share libraries and links
features.body: Create private libraries and share files or folders from the web interface.

features.title: Keep storage self-hosted
features.body: Store Seafile data and metadata in package-owned MOS volumes.

complexity.label: Advanced setup
complexity.description: Seafile runs as a multi-service package with a database, cache, and persistent file storage.

resourceHint.label: Medium resources
resourceHint.description: This package starts Seafile plus MySQL and Valkey, so it is heavier than the first single-service V2 packages.

privacy.summary: Files, metadata, and generated credentials are stored in your MOS runtime.
notes: Back up the Seafile and MySQL volumes before relying on this package for important files.
Only the Seafile web service is exposed through Caddy; MySQL and Valkey stay internal to the package network.
OnlyOffice document editing is intentionally deferred to a later integration slice.

homepage.name: Seafile
homepage.description: Sync and share files from your own server.

onboarding.title: Start using Seafile
onboarding.summary: Sign in to Seafile with the admin credentials you entered during install, then add clients or create libraries.

steps.title: Open Seafile
steps.body: Open the generated Seafile app URL after MOS reports the runtime healthy.

steps.title: Sign in with the initial admin
steps.body: Use the Seafile admin email and password you entered during install. MOS stores the password as a secret reference and does not show it again.

values.label: Admin password
values.value: Use the password you entered during install.

sections.title: OnlyOffice is deferred
sections.body: This first V2 Seafile package provides core file sync and sharing only. Browser-based office document editing will be added as a separate integration slice.

sections.title: Back up before relying on it
sections.body: Seafile stores files under /shared and metadata in MySQL. Keep both package volumes together in backups.
